narrative.overview: A calm pearl-blue system that makes VPN readiness and the next action obvious while keeping protocol detail out of the user's way. Functional glass is reserved for navigation and control; dense information stays matte.

rules.name: One Signal
rules.body: Use saturated blue for the primary action or selected state, not as decorative table fill.

rules.name: Functional Glass
rules.body: Use glass for navigation and controls; keep data surfaces matte.

rules.name: Native Wide Reflow
rules.body: At 1200px and above use the 1120px two-column grid; never scale layout with zoom or transforms.

dos: Lead with status and one next action.
Preserve safe areas, visible focus and reduced motion.
Keep wide navigation cells equal and contained at 200% text.
Keep one-word action labels intact while multiword labels reflow at spaces.
Update raster provenance and hashes when assets change.
donts: Do not claim an active or protected tunnel without measured state.
Do not show purchase actions before payments exist.
Do not expose secrets in UI captures or logs.
